title: Oozy Tagine Quesadilla
description: A twist on traditional quesadillas, this oozy tagine quesadilla combines the rich flavors of the Mediterranean with gooey cheese.

ingredients.name: mediterranean cheese
ingredients.notes: A blend of feta and ricotta cheese

instructions: 1. Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
2. Brush the tortillas with olive oil.
3. Sprinkle shredded cheese on half of each tortilla.
4. Spoon the crumbled tagine over the cheese.
5. Fold the tortillas in half to enclose the filling.
6. Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the tortillas are crispy and the cheese is melted.
7. Flip the quesadillas and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
8. Cut the quesadillas into wedges and serve hot with a side of oozy tagine spread and garnished with parsley.
9. Serve with lemon wedges on the side (optional).
